INSERT INTO pretranscodings (download_id, only_audio, audio_index)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
                    ON CONFLICT (download_id, only_audio, audio_index) DO UPDATE SET
                        status = DEFAULT,
                        error = DEFAULT,
                        transcoded_ms = DEFAULT,
                        total_ms = DEFAULT,
                        completed_at = DEFAULT,
                        created_at = DEFAULT
                RETURNING id
